fusions.name: Wringing Clasp
fusions.desc: A crushing grip that deals 30 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Grasping Loam
fusions.desc: Hands of earth rise around you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stunning each for 1 second and leaving it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Steadying Hold
fusions.desc: Sets a firm barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 10 seconds. Your armour rises by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Signet of Granite
fusions.desc: Conjures a granite signet: your critical chance rises by 5%, your critical hits deal 0.15x more, each kill returns 2 health, and your armour rises by 4%.
